technical.summary: Strong uptrend structure with EMA golden cross and new highs, but overbought oscillators and negative CMF create pullback risk; moderate entry quality on sector-neutral backdrop.

fundamental.summary: PWR shows no fundamental conviction signals—zero insider activity, no institutional positioning, no government contracts, no lobbying, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 59 days present elevated event risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (11/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity; congressional purchases show modest conviction with no recent sells; lack of news data limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (352.48) combined with flat yield curve and negative macro score (-3) creates severely unfavourable conditions; earnings in 59 days adds moderate event risk but is not imminent.

debate.key_bull_argument: EMA golden cross with price above all major MAs and new 20-day highs establish strong uptrend structure; extreme fear sentiment (11/100) and congressional buys present contrarian opportunity in capitulation zone.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought oscillators (RSI 9/14, Stoch K at 91) combined with negative CMF (-0.1849) signal imminent pullback risk; macro environment is severely unfavourable (VIX crisis at 352.48, flat yield curve, negative macro score) with earnings event risk in 59 days—entry quality is moderate at best with no active strategies triggered.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical uptrend structure (EMA golden cross, price above MAs) and extreme fear sentiment present contrarian appeal, but overbought oscillators and negative CMF signal imminent pullback risk at resistance.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis regime (352.48) combined with overbought technicals (RSI 9/14, Stoch K 91) and negative money flow create severe drawdown risk; earnings in 59 days add event uncertainty.
